# NOTE SMS SCENARIOS (invented; every name, number, agent, account and code is made up).
# NOTE
# NOTE FORMAT: scenarios are blocks separated by ONE blank line. The first line of a block is
# NOTE   # <domain> | <short note> | expect: <result> key=value key="value with spaces" ...
# NOTE the lines after it are the message exactly as pasted (keep double spaces, glued words
# NOTE like Confirmed.on or AMWithdraw, lowercase letters). An empty message is a header only.
# NOTE result: sendMoney payBill buyGoods agentWithdrawal airtime needsType notParsed tooLong
# NOTE keys (only the ones you list are checked; value none means "must be empty"):
# NOTE   amount=1200.50  fee=7.00  label="JANE DOE"  phone=0712345678  account=998877
# NOTE   agent=1234567  labellen=200 (label length, for very long agent text)
# NOTE helpers inside a message: <<REPEAT:ab:50>> = "ab" 50 times; <<PAD:2000>> = filler "x"
# NOTE   so the whole message is exactly 2000 characters long.
# NOTE a header with NO "expect:" part is REPORT MODE: nothing is asserted, the run only prints
# NOTE   one line per block (index, domain note, verdict type), never the message itself.
# NOTE
# NOTE TO ADD ONE: copy a block, change the header and the message, save. TO RUN:
# NOTE   flutter test test/domain/parsing/sms_scenarios_test.dart
# NOTE   MMOGO_SMS_SCENARIOS=<path to another file in this format> flutter test test/domain/parsing/sms_scenarios_test.dart
# NOTE (PowerShell: $env:MMOGO_SMS_SCENARIOS="<path>"; flutter test test/domain/parsing/sms_scenarios_test.dart)
# NOTE lines starting with "# NOTE" are ignored anywhere in the file.

# SendMoney | phone 07xx, fee > 0 | expect: sendMoney amount=500.00 fee=7.00 label="JANE DOE" phone=0712345678
QWE1R2T3Y4 Confirmed. Ksh500.00 sent to JANE DOE 0712345678 on 8/10/26 at 9:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh1,000.00. Transaction cost, Ksh7.00. Amount you can transact within the day is 499,000.00. Download My OneApp

# Edge | empty message | expect: notParsed

hello this is not an mpesa message at all 12345

# Edge | truncated message (cut before the date) | expect: notParsed
QWE1R2T3Y4 Confirmed. Ksh500.00 sent to JANE DOE 0712345678 on 8/1

# Edge | impossible date 31/2/26 | expect: notParsed
QWE1R2T3Y4 Confirmed. Ksh500.00 sent to JANE DOE 0712345678 on 31/2/26 at 9:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh1,000.00. Transaction cost, Ksh7.00.

# Edge | 2001 characters | expect: tooLong
QWE1R2T3Y4 Confirmed. Ksh500.00 sent to JANE DOE 0712345678 on 8/10/26 at 9:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh1,000.00. Transaction cost, Ksh7.00. <<PAD:2001>>

# Edge | exactly 2000 characters (still read) | expect: sendMoney amount=500.00 fee=7.00 label="JANE DOE" phone=0712345678
QWE1R2T3Y4 Confirmed. Ksh500.00 sent to JANE DOE 0712345678 on 8/10/26 at 9:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh1,000.00. Transaction cost, Ksh7.00. <<PAD:2000>>

# Edge | zero amount | expect: notParsed
QWE1R2T3Y4 Confirmed. Ksh0.00 sent to JANE DOE 0712345678 on 8/10/26 at 9:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh1,000.00. Transaction cost, Ksh7.00.
